attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DHCP server on the shared private network (eth1, 10.50.50.0/24) using Kea DHCP with a static gateway address 10.50.50.254, pool 10.50.50.100-200. node2 and node3 (AlmaLinux 9, already NetworkManager-managed with ipv4.method=auto on eth1) obtained dynamic leases (10.50.50.100 and 10.50.50.101 respectively) from node1's DHCP server instead of any static assignment. Performed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, confirming boot_id changes and post-restart recovery of the DHCP service (node1) and DHCP-leased addressing (node2/node3).
